```{=html}
<style>
  body {
    font-family: sans-serif;
    margin: 2rem;
  }
  /* Style the editor container */
  #editor-container {
    border: 1px solid #cbd5e1;
    border-radius: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
    max-width: 600px;
  }
  /* Give the CM editor a default height */
  .cm-editor {
    height: 300px;
  }
</style>

<div id="editor-container"></div>

<!-- Load CodeMirror 6 natively via ESM CDN -->
<script type="module">
  import { EditorView, basicSetup } from "https://esm.sh/codemirror";
  import { markdown } from "https://esm.sh/@codemirror/lang-markdown";

  const STORAGE_KEY = "cm6_markdown_bibnote";
  const SAVE_DELAY_MS = 500; // Delay before writing to storage
  const defaultDoc = "#BIBNote\n";

  // Load saved document from localStorage or fallback to default
  const savedDoc = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) ?? defaultDoc;

  // Debounced auto-save logic
  let saveTimeout;

  const debouncedAutoSave = EditorView.updateListener.of((update) => {
    if (update.docChanged) {
      clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
      saveTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        const docString = update.state.doc.toString();
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, docString);
      }, SAVE_DELAY_MS);
    }
  });

  // Initialize CodeMirror
  const view = new EditorView({
    doc: savedDoc,
    extensions: [
      basicSetup,
      markdown(),
      debouncedAutoSave
    ],
    parent: document.querySelector("#editor-container")
  });
</script>
```
